name: Tessera Industries Memory Rounds MR-2 'Recall'
description: Self-guided ammunition compatible with standard 9mm pistol platforms that uses embedded micro-processing and control surfaces to adjust trajectory in flight. Each round contains a thumbnail-sized guidance package with a micro-camera, processing chip, and four piezoelectric fin actuators that can steer the round toward a designated target up to 15 degrees off the original firing axis. The rounds are 'trained' by designating a target through a linked optic — the round's guidance package memorizes the target's visual signature and homes on it after firing. The name comes from the round's ability to 'remember' its target. Accuracy degrades rapidly beyond 30 meters as the control surfaces lack the authority to compensate for ballistic drop at range.
specifications:
caliber: 9mm compatible with standard platforms
guidance: Embedded micro-camera + piezoelectric fin steering
course correction: Up to 15 degrees off-axis
effective guided range: 5-30 meters
target designation: Visual signature lock via linked optic
weight per round: 12g (2g heavier than standard 9mm)
processing: Onboard micro-chip, single-use
fin actuators: 4 piezoelectric surfaces
story_hooks: A target was killed by a 9mm round that forensic analysis shows changed direction mid-flight — the entry angle is physically impossible from any firing position in the room without guidance.
A shipment of Memory Rounds has been intercepted with their guidance packages pre-locked to specific individuals — someone manufactured assassination rounds targeted at a specific hit list.

physical_description.visual_profile: A 9mm round with a distinctly bulbous, asymmetrical nose cone housing the guidance package. The projectile appears slightly oversized compared to standard ammunition, with four barely-visible control surface fins arranged around the midsection. The casing is polished brass with a subtle iridescent sheen from embedded circuitry beneath the surface. At first glance it resembles a hollowpoint round, but closer inspection reveals micro-circuitry traces etched along the jacket.
physical_description.dimensions: 24mm length (standard 9mm), 9mm diameter, 6mm fin span on control surfaces. Nose cone extends 8mm beyond typical round profile
physical_description.weight_description: Noticeably heavier than standard 9mm—12 grams versus 8g standard load. Sits with a slight forward bias in the palm, making it feel almost alive when rolling between fingers
physical_description.primary_material: Brass casing with electroplated copper jacket, tungsten-core projectile body, silicon-carbide nose cone housing the guidance package
physical_description.finish: High-polish brass with hairline circuit traces visible under magnification. Nose cone has a matte gunmetal gray finish with subtle iridescent oil-slick rainbow shimmer from the guidance optics beneath. Casing mouth shows bright copper—freshly manufactured appearance
physical_description.color_scheme: Polished brass primary, matte gunmetal gray nose cone, copper rim and primer cup, with barely-visible copper circuit traces running the length of the casing
physical_description.grip_texture: Not gripped directly—exists as loose ammunition, but the casing has a smooth, almost slick finish from the electroplating
distinctive_features: Bulbous, asymmetrical nose cone with embedded micro-lens visible as tiny transparent window
Four equidistant piezoelectric control surface fins around the midsection—slightly raised, metallic gray
Hairline circuit traces etched in copper along the casing length
Tiny branding mark: 'TESSERA MR-2' stamped just above the primer
Almost imperceptible weight shift toward nose—guidance package creates balance offset
Primer cup appears slightly recessed compared to standard rounds, housing connection point for initialization
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: 'TESSERA INDUSTRIES' in micro-stamped lettering along the casing shoulder, 'MR-2 RECALL' beneath it. Serial batch number stamped on the rim (e.g., '226-HV-847'). Lucid Dreams Sleep Technology licensing mark embossed in tiny text on the nose cone base
physical_description.condition_typical: Factory fresh—polished and pristine. These are single-use, prohibited munitions, so civilian/black-market examples are always new or carefully preserved. Any wear indicates field testing or recovered-from-corpse retrieval
